summary: TC Energy filed a 6-K announcing an agreement to sell Energía Occidente de México, owner of the 313-km Guadalajara-Manzanillo Pipeline, to ESENTIA Energy Development affiliates for a gross purchase price of $560 million (US$400 million) in cash. The pipeline transports up to 500 MMcf/d, connecting LNG and continental supply to power and industrial customers in Colima and Jalisco. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to customary conditions, regulatory approvals and consents. Proceeds will fund portfolio optimization and North American growth; watch regulatory timing and any purchase-price adjustments.
